response.sql: SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.mktnote AS trading_pair, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebate_rate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: AVG and SUM ignore NULLs by default; a group whose rebtotal values are all NULL yields a NULL total and is sorted last.
Fees with NULL feerate are excluded by the feerate >= 0.0009 filter.
